title: CollectionInput
description: Write model of a collection release record (Ingest API `PUT /collections/{external_id}`, admin catalog). Products and variants point at it with `collection_external_id`; a value without a record holds nothing.

brand_external_id.description: MAY be omitted when the node has exactly one brand.

name.description: Display name. Unique per brand and season among records (409 `conflict`); not used for membership.

state.description: held: the collection's products, their variants and assets are not visible to any retailer. released: visible. Omitted on create: `held` when `release_at` is in the future, else `released`; omitted on replace: kept.

release_at.description: Scheduled release, a MAY of proposal 0006 (capability `collections.scheduled_release`). A node that offers it: while `state` is `held` and this moment has passed, it releases the collection (state becomes `released`, `released_at` = this value). A node without it answers a future value with 422 `validation_failed` (pointer `/release_at`); a value in the past releases now on every node. null = no schedule.

released_at.description: Read-only (Ingest GET): when the collection last became visible, null while it never was. Ignored on write.
